responsibility: Main implementation file for the ARC GCC backend, covering target hooks and RTL-side code generation policy for ARC processors. It owns target option-dependent state such as selected CPU properties, interrupt-save behavior, and conditional-execution tracking; implements backend helpers for operand/address legitimacy, constants and constraints, builtin and atomic support, prologue/epilogue and return handling, instruction costing, branch/delay-slot and if-conversion logic, assembly output details, and other targetm hooks that connect ARC-specific ABI, instruction selection, scheduling/cost, and final code emission behavior to the generic compiler.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable backend implementation file in the arc stem group, providing the target hook functions and RTL/code-generation logic and instantiating targetm. Unlike arc.h it declares configuration macros and interfaces, unlike arc.md it encodes instruction patterns and attributes, and unlike arc.opt it declares command-line options rather than implementing backend behavior.
